description: This PHP class file defines the Candidate entity for the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties, constructors, getters, and setters to manage candidate data such as names, contact info, application details, and relationships with other entities like CandidateVacancy and CandidateAttachment.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: Represents a job candidate in the recruitment system, including personal details, application info, and relationships with vacancies, attachments, and history.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comments related to the candidate.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets comments related to the candidate.

methods.name: getModeOfApplication
methods.description: Retrieves the mode of application (manual or online).

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves keywords associated with the candidate.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets keywords associated with the candidate.

methods.name: getAddedPerson
methods.description: Retrieves the employee who added the candidate.

methods.name: setAddedPerson
methods.description: Sets the employee who added the candidate.

methods.name: isConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Checks if the candidate has given consent to keep data.
